size_rationale: Small because it is a one-line fix in one file, and the quoted error 'Email already taken' is thrown on the line right after the inverted check in createUser.
prompt: POST /v1/auth/register fails with 400 'Email already taken' for every new email address, including ones that have never been registered. Admins creating users via POST /v1/users get the same error.

root_cause.detail: createUser's duplicate check is inverted: it throws 'Email already taken' exactly when the email is free.

fail_to_pass: tests/integration/auth.test.js > Auth routes > POST /v1/auth/register > should return 201 and successfully register user if request data is ok
tests/integration/user.test.js > User routes > POST /v1/users > should return 201 and successfully create new user if data is ok
oracle.cmd: npx jest tests/integration/auth.test.js tests/integration/user.test.js -t 'should return 201 and successfully register user if request data is ok|should return 201 and successfully create new user if data is ok'
